changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwencounterattachments AS SELECT ea.id, ea.encounter_id, ea.created_by, ea.space_key, ea.filename, ea.mime_type, ea.size_bytes, ea.created_date, ea.deleted_at, ea.type, ea.details, ea.source, ea.source_id, ea.last_modified_by, ea.last_modified_date, ea.document_definition_id, ea.document_version_id FROM public.encounter_attachments ea;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwencounterattachments TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwencounterattachments FROM report_user;
